'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Jacob Adams LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jacob Adams]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Numpty Power in BFred's Used Car Lot. Pluto Gandish → [[Phylo Gandish]]. Sheet Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & Out of Nowhere → [[Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & •Out Of Somewhere]].

* '''Player:''' [[Jacob Adams]]

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
